name: Ester Industries Ltd
title: Ester Industries Ltd - 500136 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: BOPET film margins look to have troughed: Q4 consolidated adjusted EBITDA margin 15.5% and Filmtech utilisation 85%, but Specialty Polymers volumes softened and reported EBITDA ex-MTM was still only 12.6%.

utilisation.quote: Consolidated capacity utilization for Q4 FY26 stood at approximately 78% with Ester Filmtech operating at 85% and Ester Industries at 72%.

capex.quote: the total capex that we are planning for next year is around INR70 crores

triggers.label: Anti-dumping duties on China BOPET imports
triggers.quote: the Directorate General of Trade Remedies, DGTR, has imposed antidumping duties on BOPET film imports from China

triggers.label: 12-micron VA spread ~INR32-33 in Q4
triggers.quote: the average spread in Q4 was around INR 32 to INR33 for 12-micron VA

triggers.label: Industry operating rate ~80%
triggers.quote: the Indian manufacturers are operating at an OR, operating rate, of 80%

triggers.label: Specialty Polymers Q4 volume moderation
triggers.quote: While Q4 FY26 saw some volume moderation in our core specialty products

guidance.quote: the sustenance of BOPET margins is going to continue for around 18 to 24 months at least
Specialty Polymer, can we do INR200 crores revenue this year?
we expect the commencement of operations by the last calendar quarter of '28
the total capex that we are planning for next year is around INR70 crores
we are trying to limit our borrowings for the next year to below INR 40 crores

prior_guidance_check.quote: the transformative ELITe project advancing, albeit with some delays

red_flags.label: Specialty Polymers demand loss on marquee product, unquantified
red_flags.quote: there was also an issue related to demand of one of our key specialty products

red_flags.label: Euro loan MTM losses ₹37.4 crores FY26
red_flags.quote: cumulative noncash mark -to-market losses on foreign currency liabilities

red_flags.label: Net loss FY26 and thin PAT
red_flags.quote: the company reported a net loss of INR27.5 crores

evasions.topic: Specialty Polymers marquee product demand impact
evasions.quote: right now, we don't want to take a call on that until the situation becomes clear
we are still assessing the situation
it will be difficult at this point of time to give you a precise number
